name: Platform Hosting Card Delete
description: From the project payments page, when a card is on file, the client sees an 'Eliminar tarjeta' button next to 'Cambiar tarjeta'. Clicking it opens a confirmation modal warning that automatic billing will be disabled. On confirm, DELETE /api/accounts/projects/:id/subscription/card/remove/ best-effort deletes the Wompi payment source and clears the stored card fields on the subscription, so has_payment_source becomes false and the 'Activa el cobro automático / Registrar tarjeta' state reappears. The button is hidden for admins and for archived subscriptions.
knownGaps: Spec added 2026-07-23 (QA campaign round 5): confirm delete restoring the register state, cancel without API call, and the in-modal error branch over mocked API.
